# `collab/CollabPresence.js`

> **Source:** `engine/collab/CollabPresence.js`

CollabPresence.js Tracks all peers' camera positions, usernames, selections, and colors. Presence packet: { v:1, u:username, c:[x,y,z], t:[tx,ty,tz], s:[entityIds] } Current scope: lossy latest-state presence. Authenticated presence identity, sequence/freshness fields, cross-system stale-peer cleanup, interpolation ownership, and captured churn traces remain audit gaps.
